Hannah (finance-ops): Heads-up: several invoices created in NetSuite have no linked Stripe charge_id after last night's sync. Customers are showing unpaid but charges exist in Stripe. Noticed around 03:17-03:25 window.
webhook-bot: sync-job completed: job_id=ns-sync-2026-05-01-03, processed_invoices=4, missing_links=6
Leo (eng-platform): That's the window where we throttled outbound requests to Stripe and switched to the async retryer. Might be a sequencing bug where invoice rows are inserted before the charge mapping arrives.
Priya (billing-sre): I see errors in the webhook consumer: "order mismatch: invoice_row created after mapping consumed". Looks like concurrent workers processed payment events out of order when backfill=false.
Julian (accounting): Impact: those 6 invoices are marked past_due in NetSuite and triggered dunning emails. We need to avoid sending debtor notices until we re-link. Please pause dunning workflow.
Hannah (finance-ops): Pause requested: dunning.pause=true for today. Also want a query to find affected rows so we can reconcile.
Priya (billing-sre): Quick query to surface suspects:
```
SELECT i.id, i.net_amount, i.created_at, p.stripe_charge_id
FROM invoices i
LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.invoice_id = i.id
WHERE i.created_at BETWEEN '2026-05-01 03:10' AND '2026-05-01 03:30'
AND p.stripe_charge_id IS NULL;
```

Running now.
webhook-bot: reconciliation-scan result=6 rows ids=[inv_9981,inv_9982,inv_9983,inv_9984,inv_9985,inv_9986]
Leo (eng-platform): Root cause: async-retryer re-enqueued payment-mapping events without preserving original sequence_order header. When worker A writes invoice and worker B later writes mapping, the mapping replace path skips because sequence_order is lower. Fix: preserve sequence_order in retry envelope. I'll open PR.
Hannah (finance-ops): Remediation plan:
- pause dunning and scheduled invoice emails until reconciliation complete
- replay payment mapping events for the 03:10-03:30 window
- run re-link script to attach stripe_charge_id to invoices and remove dunning flags
Need Jon to approve replay and any manual adjustments if automated re-link fails.
Jon (CFO): Approve replay and automated re-link. If more than 20 customers need manual touches, escalate to me.
Priya (billing-sre): Kicking off replay job: replay-2210004567-1 for payments 03:10-03:30. ETA ~8m.
webhook-bot: replay_job started job_id=replay-2210004567-1 events=24
Leo (eng-platform): PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/ops/pull/12888 -- keeps sequence_order on retry envelopes. Deploying to canary.
webhook-bot: replay_job complete job_id=replay-2210004567-1 processed=24 relinked=6 conflicts=0 audit_log=/logs/replay-2210004567-1
Julian (accounting): Confirmed invoices now show linked charges in NetSuite, dunning flags cleared. I'll verify statements and notify affected customers that notices were sent in error.
Hannah (finance-ops): Thanks. Please include a short postmortem and add an alert for missing sequence_order on retries.
Priya (billing-sre): Will add alert and follow-up runbook. Closing. :white_check_mark:
